text.tspan: Foreign aid spent in recipient countries2010 to 2024
Net official development assistance (ODA) that is spent in recipient countries, rather than domestic activities —
such as administration and the hosting of refugees — within the donor country. This data is expressed in US
dollars and is adjusted for inflation.
Note: This data is expressed in constant 2024 US$.
